profile.headline: Software Engineer at Databricks
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with 6+ years of experience. I’m currently working for Databricks. I had the privilege of working in multiple projects and gain experience from different areas, for example: data warehousing, web development, application development, and big data.  

I’m truly passionate about my work and always eager to connect with other LinkedIn members. While I enjoy all aspects of my job, I think my favorite stage of a project is developing the solution and release the final product. As we go through the development process, the client gets excited to see how his or her idea turns into a solution and that is always the fun part.

I have a B.S. in Software Engineering from San Jose State University.

I’m always interested in hearing from former colleagues, manager, or just interesting creative folks, so feel free to contact me if you would like to connect. 

Specialties: software development, big data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a Hadoop data lake to analyze terabytes of data both in real-time and batch processing for one of the biggest insurance company. Migrated many legacy archives systems to Hadoop. Designed data ingestion pipelines and modeling data for analysis.

	Created Hive tables, load transaction data and logs from multiple source systems using Flume and Sqoop.
	Experience with data ingestion and processing into HDFS using Flume, Hive and Sqoop.
	Worked on full stack, designed and built systems on Hadoop, Flume, Hive, Elasticsearch and integrated with web front end.
	Developed a package of java programs to optimize and reduce the time it takes to do incremental updates on Hive by 70%.
	Orchestrated hundreds of Sqoop scripts and Hive queries using Oozie workflows for daily incremental.
	Optimized Hive queries by creating ORC tables and customize Tez options. 
	Developed UDF’s for Hive. Developed various scripts to automate data table creation in Hive.
	Data present in Hive file system will also be used by other systems within the organization.
	Participated in daily scrum meetings and iterative deployment.
	Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.

Developed a real-time analytics solution for one of the industry’s leading network management platforms. Developed and customize software for diverse client base

	Managed an offshore team of 4 software engineers for multiple projects.
	Process real-time data from a source system using Prime Analytics to populate database to feed into visualization for use cases defined (data Consumer + Handlers + Streams). Co-developed a dynamic, secure web site from scratch. Launched visually appealing, user-friendly with interactive features to optimize traffic, page views and user experience.
	Excelled in rapid application development and management of technological issues for assigned projects, earning a good satisfaction rating for all software solutions delivered.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Assisted in the design and development of data warehouse solutions for a leading networking services company.

	During the internship period I received training in Linux, SQL, PL/SQL, business intelligence concepts, data warehouse, data mining, ETL and report/dash board tools. 
	Worked in small group where I gained hands on exposure to full project life-cycle. 
	Created a data warehouse dimensional model. Used Informatica Powercenter (ETL tool) to create data marts and developed a semantic layer using business objects to create intuitive reports.

projects.title: US Cyber Challenge: Cyber Quest
projects.description:
- Attended to the US Cyber Quest preparation day camp at San Jose State University.
- Participated in the US Cyber Challenge: Cyber Quest April 2013 to qualify for the US Cyber Camp 2013.
- Packet capture-based Web vulnerability analysis using Wireshark.
- Identify and interpret various attack vectors for network and web application.

projects.title: Android Video Game
projects.description:
- Designed and built a "classic" mobile game using a free Android 2D OpenGL game engine.
- Used collision detection, physics, and multi-touch capabilities to make the game more interactive.
- Designed 2D sprites to create moving animations.
- Made the game Open Source and public using GitHub.
